messages.subject: Effects order with 2-SPDE model
parts:
Hello, 
I am noodling around with spatial models with heteroskedastic noise. 
I am stuck with something, would you please help me out ?

In a "vanilla" Matern-SPDE model, $summary.fitted.values allows to retrieve statistics (mean, sd, etc) of the Matérn latent field, at each of the 10000 spatial location. 
However, when I add another spde to model nonstationary noise, I cannot retrieve those statistics. The first 10000 $summary.fitted.values are now the observations. The following 10000 seem to be the residuals. Of course, I would prefer to have the latent field instead ! I think that my stack is wrong, but I could not put my finger on what is wrong. 

Here is a sample code for illustration. The first part generates synthetic data. The second fits the ``vanilla'' Matérn model. The third part fits a model with heteroskedastic noise and presents my problem with  $summary.fitted.values. 

Thank you all in advance !
Sébastien
